idea.title: Loreline – Tools for writing interactive fiction

plan.tagline: Automates invoice tracking and reminders for freelancers and small businesses
plan.problem: Manual invoice tracking and follow-ups are time-consuming and prone to errors
plan.solution: InvoiceChase allows users to add invoices, track their status, and receive reminders for follow-ups, all from a simple command-line interface
plan.target_market: Indie hackers, developers, and small businesses worldwide, particularly those with limited resources and a need for efficient invoicing
mvp_features: Add invoices with client details and due dates
List all invoices with their status
Mark invoices as paid or pending
Generate reports on invoice status and client payments
Send reminders for upcoming invoice due dates

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: Design a SQLite schema to store invoices and implement add and list commands

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: Implement report generation for invoice status and client payments, and add notification system for reminders

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: Implement --demo mode with hardcoded data, add --help documentation, and handle edge cases

plan.demo_script: The --demo mode shows 5 invoices with different statuses, demonstrates adding a new invoice, and displays a report on client payments
plan.phuket_angle: None, but could be marketed to tourism-related businesses in Phuket, such as freelance tour guides or small hotels, who need to manage invoices for their services
